controlled_change.target_source: Admitted real TRAIN population frequency only, not ownership or evaluation labels

interpretation: The bounded numeric sampler change improves the balanced internal digit count by six and the total internal count by ten. Owned token hits and Top-5 complete formulas also rise, but a previously correct formula is lost and no previously wrong formula is corrected. This change does not satisfy formula nonregression and is not adopted. Small consumed-diagnostic differences are not proof that numeric sampling is universally harmful.
next_research_boundary: Keep V29 as the best directly retrained research formula reference and canonical as product champion. Do not escalate augmentation volume on the basis of isolated digit gains. Audit remaining decision-near rival preservation before another controlled objective change; all coefficient fitting remains TRAIN-only.
verification_scope: All recorded losses and 57-gradient/four-layer scopes checked; numeric floor and unchanged augmentation independently verified; eight final TRAIN gap gradients and NumPy losses checked; final checkpoint logits reloaded bit-exact. Not a full replay of historical intermediate forwards.
limits: Consumed 149-formula oracle-group diagnostic; 95 cases were historical canonical calibration input and 53 additional annotations were Codex-reviewed. No fresh writer/device acceptance or official Expression Rate.
